text:
Hi everyone, I have a question. My partner and I are married and currently in the process of getting his visa. He is currently outside of Israel and I’m in Israel.

About two and a half weeks ago, I had an interview where I had to present all of our documents, and since then I’ve been waiting for a response. I’ve already sent two emails trying to understand roughly when I can expect an update, and each time I was told that when there’s news, they’ll update me.

This situation is really frustrating, and I’m sure many people here have experienced it too. My question is: is there anything I can do in the meantime? About how long did it take for you to receive an answer? Does anyone happen to have a contact person at the Netanya office who might be able to help?

It’s been really difficult for both me and my partner. We’ve been apart since November. I honestly thought that because we’re married and we have been together almost 5 years and I submitted all the documents, the process would move faster, but apparently not.

Thank you in advance.
